column1: # Clues written for CrossWordle in the style of a British quick crossword (the Guardian Quick,
# the Times Quick): short definitions and synonyms, a few fill-in-the-blanks, two meanings joined
# by a dash, the odd playful one. Original work, not copied from any newspaper.
# About 4,500 answers: familiar general words (those with the most Open English WordNet senses,
# less the dull "-NESS" and "-LY" fill), plus the kind of vocabulary newspaper setters use:
# animals, food, household things, clothes, music, sport, nature, people and places, and livelier
# words such as ASTUTE, GAZEBO and MIASMA. Daily puzzles only use answers clued here. See
# README.md for the style guide. Hand edits and exclusions go in edits.tsv, which overrides this
